basic_details.job_title: Gauhati High Court Usher Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: One clear vacant post of Usher in the Principal Seat of the Gauhati High Court (High Court of Assam, Nagaland, Mizoram and Arunachal Pradesh) is to be filled from among the Multi Tasking Staff of its Registry. Willing staff must submit their option to the Establishment Section on or before 17 November 2026. The notice is open only to the Registry's Multi Tasking Staff, not to outside candidates.

qualification.details: The notice covers 01 (one) clear vacant post of Usher in the Principal Seat of the Gauhati High Court. | Who may submit an option: intending Multi Tasking Staff of the Registry of the Gauhati High Court. Staff posted outside the court building: the notice is to be circulated amongst Multi-Tasking Staff of the Registry including those working in the Bungalows of Hon'ble Judges, Residences of Officers and the Judges' Guest House. Qualification: the official notification does not specify the minimum educational qualification; candidates only have to state their qualification in the option. Age and pay: not specified in the notice. | Candidates should check the official notification for any further eligibility details for the post.

important_instructions: The notice was copied to the Registrars, Joint, Deputy and Assistant Registrars, the Court Officer-I, Court Masters and other officers, who are requested to circulate it amongst the Multi Tasking Staff working under their administrative control. The Administrative Officer (Judicial) is directed to inform the Multi Tasking Staff of the Section. The notice is also displayed on the Gauhati High Court Notice Board (Old Block and New Block) and is to be uploaded on the official website of the Principal Seat of the Gauhati High Court.

content_sections.heading: About Gauhati High Court
content_sections.text: The Gauhati High Court at Guwahati is the High Court of Assam, Nagaland, Mizoram and Arunachal Pradesh. This notice was issued by the Registrar (Establishment) and concerns a vacancy in the Principal Seat of the High Court at Guwahati, to be filled from staff already working in its Registry.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Willing staff must submit their option to the Establishment Section of the Gauhati High Court on or before 17 November 2026. The notice does not prescribe a form, a postal mode or an email address; the option is handed to the Establishment Section. The option must mention: Qualification Date of birth Date of initial appointment in the Registry Other relevant details ("etc." as printed in the notice)

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: The notice covers 01 (one) clear vacant post of Usher in the Principal Seat of the Gauhati High Court. Who may submit an option: intending Multi Tasking Staff of the Registry of the Gauhati High Court. Staff posted outside the court building: the notice is to be circulated amongst Multi-Tasking Staff of the Registry including those working in the Bungalows of Hon'ble Judges, Residences of Officers and the Judges' Guest House. Qualification: the official notification does not specify the minimum educational qualification; candidates only have to state their qualification in the option. Age and pay: not specified in the notice. Candidates should check the official notification for any further eligibility details for the post.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The notice was copied to the Registrars, Joint, Deputy and Assistant Registrars, the Court Officer-I, Court Masters and other officers, who are requested to circulate it amongst the Multi Tasking Staff working under their administrative control. The Administrative Officer (Judicial) is directed to inform the Multi Tasking Staff of the Section. The notice is also displayed on the Gauhati High Court Notice Board (Old Block and New Block) and is to be uploaded on the official website of the Principal Seat of the Gauhati High Court.

faq.question: Q1. How many Usher vacancies are there in the Gauhati High Court notice?
faq.answer: There is 01 (one) clear vacant post of Usher in the Principal Seat of the Gauhati High Court.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to submit the option for the Usher post?
faq.answer: Willing staff must submit their option on or before 17 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. Who can apply for the Gauhati High Court Usher post?
faq.answer: Only the intending Multi Tasking Staff of the Registry of the Gauhati High Court can submit an option; outside candidates are not invited.

faq.question: Q4. Where should the option be submitted?
faq.answer: The option is submitted to the Establishment Section of the Gauhati High Court.

faq.question: Q5. What details must the option contain?
faq.answer: The option must mention the qualification, date of birth and date of initial appointment in the Registry, among other details.

faq.question: Q6. Can Multi Tasking Staff working in Judges' bungalows submit an option?
faq.answer: Yes. The notice is to be circulated amongst Multi-Tasking Staff of the Registry including those working in the Bungalows of Hon'ble Judges, Residences of Officers and the Judges' Guest House.

faq.question: Q7. Where is the Usher post located?
faq.answer: The post is in the Principal Seat of the Gauhati High Court at Guwahati.

faq.question: Q8. What is the notice number of the Gauhati High Court Usher notice?
faq.answer: The notice number is HC.V-94/2023/776/Estt., dated 3 November 2026.
